title: AstraZeneca's COPD drug scores two late-stage trial wins as full data boosts blockbuster hopes
summary_full: The full data reinforces hopes that the drug could be a breakthrough COPD treatment and reach AstraZeneca's peak annual sales forecast of more than $5 billion.
